missions.title: The Ultimate Weapon
missions.desc: Year 100. A Government car pulls up beside the Xeno Warriors.

lines.t: You two - and you! The Government needs your help. There's a war on.
lines.group: You two - and all of you! The Government needs your help. There's a war on.

lines.t: C1 made a chip that lets a human use 100% of themselves. We called him Ultima. A virus got in. He's killing everyone.
Only his sister, Yuri. And we believe she was killed.
MY golden time has finally come! Government property? Once I kill you all, there IS no Government.
Mikiko, Rhalix... and you. I've read every file. Every video. I know what you'll do before you do it.
lines.group: Mikiko, Rhalix... and all of you. I've read every file. I know what you'll do before you do it.

lines.t: Then you should know this too - we are the Xeno Warriors!

steps.obj: Stand with the Xeno Warriors against Ultima

lines.t: Hahaha... this isn't over. This is only my retribution's beginning.
Sky Patrol, the farm, the Rebellion, the Government... you've been everywhere. You're one of us now.
lines.group: Sky Patrol, the farm, the Rebellion, the Government... you've all been everywhere. You're Xeno Warriors now.

lines.t: Season 1 complete! Every character is now yours to play.
